erratum: SRCTF v1 — quantify the capacity criterion, define attempt validity, and fix opponent naming

admissibility.what_this_changes: resolves one undefined term, records one already-implied distinction, and fixes a naming scheme
admissibility.what_this_does_not_change: the latent-free acceptance criterion, the four dilemmas, the reward rule, the freeze point, the downstream gate sequence, or the prohibition list

repair_1_the_capacity_criterion_was_unqu.the_defect: 'the offence/contest correlation must be materially WEAKER than the historical r = -0.898' left 'materially' undefined. Faced with -0.72, -0.60 or -0.40 the experimenter would retain discretion after seeing the result.

the_frozen_rule.statistic: r_offence_contest = Pearson correlation between offensive_pressure and red_contest_fraction across the SRCTF opponent population, measured exactly as in C6 Stage 1
the_frozen_rule.point_threshold_rationale: -0.70 corresponds to roughly half the shared variance of the historical -0.898 (0.49 vs 0.81). Chosen before any SRCTF number exists.
the_frozen_rule.ci_condition_rationale: requires positive evidence that SRCTF differs from the cramped baseline, not merely a point estimate that happens to land higher
the_frozen_rule.bootstrap: resample opponents, 2000 resamples, seed 12345, inherited from the C4/C5 contract

repair_1_the_capacity_criterion_was_unqu.acknowledged_limitation: the population is ~6-8 opponents, so the correlation CI will be wide and the CI condition is demanding. That is deliberate: a capacity claim on a handful of opponents SHOULD be hard to make. If the CI condition proves unreachable at this population size, that is a finding about the measurement, and enlarging the population requires its own preregistration -- not a relaxed bar.

repair_2_valid_versus_invalid_attempts.why_needed: ONE_SHOT must not be triggered by a run that never happened scientifically. C6 produced two STAGE1_FAILs in which the opponent profiles resolved correctly, passed every identity check, and never reached the simulator -- the families behaved identically because the BT activation mask enumerated levels. Those were plumbing failures, and treating either as the design's one shot would have closed a design on a bug.
repair_2_valid_versus_invalid_attempts.VALID_attempt: all reachability preconditions verified, THEN the frozen scanner consumes the qualification block. A failure here permanently closes the design.
repair_2_valid_versus_invalid_attempts.INVALID_attempt: any run in which a verified plumbing, identity, or trajectory-reachability failure occurred. Scientifically the attempt never began; it does not consume the one shot and does not close the design.
reachability_preconditions_that_must_pas: resolution identity gate (canonicalization, levels, membership, tables)
behavioural trajectory-hash guard: every SRCTF opponent must produce a DISTINCT red trajectory from an identical seed, and none may match a legacy opponent
dispatch reachability: every SRCTF opponent must actually reach the BT brain
repair_2_valid_versus_invalid_attempts.the_boundary: once those pass and the scanner touches the qualification block, that IS the one shot. Discovering a bug afterwards does not retroactively invalidate a consumed attempt -- which is why the guards run first.
repair_2_valid_versus_invalid_attempts.anti_abuse: 'invalid' requires a VERIFIED mechanical failure with evidence recorded in the artifact. A disappointing result is never grounds for declaring an attempt invalid.

repair_3_opponent_naming.the_rule: SRCTF opponents are named for WHAT THEY DO, with no OP prefix and no numbering

names.FORTRESS: strong home allocation, weak offensive throughput
names.ADAPTIVE: changes allocation according to score and game state

why_this_is_a_safety_improvement_and_not.measured: in the historical roster the type-names are actively WRONG. canonicalize_opponent_key resolves OP9_FORTRESS -> OP9_SPLIT_LANE_FEINT, OP10_ESCORT -> OP10_AGGRESSIVE_INTERCEPTOR, OP8_INTERCEPTOR -> OP8_PROTECTED_CARRIER_ESCORT, and OP6_TURTLE -> OP6_IMMEDIATE_DUAL_RUSH.
why_this_is_a_safety_improvement_and_not.consequence: reading a name told you the opposite of the behaviour. That is precisely the confusion recorded in C6_ERRATUM_ROSTER_CHARACTERIZATION.json, where I described the mixture from alias names and got it backwards.
why_this_is_a_safety_improvement_and_not.the_structural_fix: the damage came from the ALIAS/SYNONYM layer, not from bare names. SRCTF names are therefore CANONICAL ONLY -- no aliases, no synonyms, no historical tags. A name resolves to itself or the run aborts.

required_tests: no SRCTF name collides with any historical alias, synonym, canonical name, or SUPPORTED_OPPONENTS entry (verified: zero exact collisions today)
canonicalize_opponent_key(name) == name for every SRCTF opponent
no entry is added to OPPONENT_SYNONYMS for any SRCTF opponent
the name a profile carries matches the mechanics its knobs implement, asserted in the qualification artifact
repair_3_opponent_naming.TURTLE_deliberately_not_used: reserved historical confusable -- OP6_TURTLE already denotes a dual rush. FORTRESS carries the home-heavy role instead, as a canonical name with no alias.

immutability: After any SRCTF measurement exists, none of the above may change.
